nota: Tiempos exactos: la pista es la concatenación de los audios de cada segmento con pausas fijas.

segmentos.texto: I'm sitting in a small café near the river, and I'm writing this postcard in the sun.
It's warm and sunny today, and the sky is very blue.
It has seven hills, so I walk up and down all day!
The streets are narrow, and old yellow trams go up the hills.
Right now, a tram is passing in front of the café, and a man is playing the guitar on the corner.
I'm staying in a small hotel in the old town.
The owner, Mrs. Costa, makes fresh bread every morning, and she always gives me an extra piece of cake.
I don't understand much Portuguese, but the people here are very friendly, and a lot of them speak English.
Tomorrow I'm visiting the castle, and on Saturday I'm taking a boat trip on the river.
